name: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited
summary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited engages in the design, technology, manufacturing, supply and supervision for installation and commissioning of equipment for the treatment of wastewater and solid waste in India and internationally. The company offers Cyclic activated sludge technology (C-Tech), a technology for treating sewage and effluents. The company's C-Tech technology solutions include decanters, diffusers, air blowers, fiber disc filters, solar sludge drying system along with programmable logic controllers, and supervisory control and data acquisition-based automation solutions; and operations and maintenance services, and related accessories.
